summary: Documentation only: design/portability.md (portability roadmap phases 1-3) and eleven ADRs with status proposed (0109-0119; the status-sinks ADR renumbered from 0107 to 0109, with ADR-0107/0108 now owned by the protocol-spec and node-assessment PRs), plus the regenerated ADR index. No code, configuration, version, workflow, checker or review-policy change; nothing proposed here is built. Each ADR's code references were checked against origin/main (fb19cb6). The review looked at whether the proposals, if later built as written, would weaken a trust boundary, and whether each names the security constraints it must keep: ADR-0118 keeps every adapter in the repository and forbids loading code named by configuration (preserves ADR-0055/0074/0075, TM-16); ADR-0109 names the webhook sink as new egress with timeout and retry bounds (B9, TM-08) and proposes removing the router's MQTT credential from every node's bundle (pre-existing, see findings); ADR-0110 keeps the cloud data-class, privacy, credential-scan, egress and budget checks before the backend call (B6/B7, TM-05); ADR-0111 keeps the node-side path allowlist as a per-runtime constant in the signed binary and requires a TM-11 review for each new runtime; ADR-0112 requires a vendor library to be loaded only from the system path and to fail closed (B8, TM-14); ADR-0114 and ADR-0115 keep owner isolation, deletion-journal replay and the memory safeguards for every engine/backend (B4/B5, TM-09, TM-12); ADR-0116 keeps pinning, hash locks, non-root, read-only configuration and provenance for the image (TM-14, TM-16); ADR-0117 keeps the rule that the router chooses only the Ollama version and the agent verifies against its node-local source (B8, TM-13) and names webhook/IPMI wakers as new egress with credentials (B9); ADR-0119 makes an unrecognised tool format fail closed for clients with redaction configured (B6, TM-05). The texts name no host, address, person or deployment path.

findings.evidence: Pre-existing, read in code: router/skirnir_router/registry.py provision_bundle (lines 142-154) puts the router's own MQTT username and password (read_mqtt_password, line 135) into the provisioning bundle of every approved node with MQTT enabled. Attacker prerequisite: control of an approved node. Impact: publish or subscribe on the broker with the router's identity, e.g. forge router state topics read by home automation. Controls today: operator approval of nodes (ADR-0009), the per-node policy switch policy.mqtt, broker-side ACLs if the operator configures them. Confidence high.
findings.resolution: Not introduced by this change (documentation only, no code touched). ADR-0109 proposes a per-node MQTT login or none in the bundle, with a negative test that the bundle carries the router's password only when no per-node login is configured; the fix belongs to the PR that implements ADR-0109.

tests.evidence: security_relevant false; 13 changed paths (design/portability.md, eleven ADRs, docs/adr/README.md).
Public-change scan: 0 finding(s); manual review of the added lines found no host, address, person or ops path.

limitations: Documentation only; the proposals are reviewed as designs, not as code. Each implementing PR needs its own review against the then-current code.
Line references in the ADRs are for origin/main at fb19cb6; parallel PRs (structured problems, agent without NVIDIA, secrets renderer, locale-neutral router) change some of the cited code.
The pre-existing shared MQTT credential is recorded here but not added to the risk register; that is the maintainer's call.

python test/check_adr_index.py FAILS on this branch alone, and CI will show it: the index table matches the files (regenerated with --write, 111 ADRs), but the check also requires consecutive numbers and reports 'numbers not consecutive from 0001: [... 100, 109, 110, ...]', because ADR-0101..0108 are owned by parallel PRs that are not yet on main. After the renumbering this PR comes after all of them in the merge order (rebased after the previous merge), so the check is green once ADR-0101..0108 are on main.
